title: User authentication with Google OAuth
description: Verify that users can successfully authenticate using Google OAuth and receive appropriate roles assigned by the superadministrator.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Attempt to sign in via Google OAuth using valid account credentials
Confirm that the user is authenticated successfully and redirected to the dashboard
Validate that the user session contains the correct role assigned by the superadministrator

title: User authentication failure with invalid Google credentials
description: Ensure that authentication fails when incorrect or revoked Google OAuth credentials are used.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Attempt to sign in using invalid or revoked Google OAuth credentials
Verify that authentication is denied and the user is shown an appropriate error message

title: Create a new project with valid data
description: Test the creation of a new project with all required fields filled correctly.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher
Navigate to the project creation form
Fill in all mandatory fields: title, summary, keywords, proponentEntity, optional fields startDate, endDate, budget, isPublic
Submit the project creation form
Verify that the project is created with correct data and a 201 created response is returned
Confirm that the project is accessible in the user's dashboard and in the database

title: Create a project with missing mandatory fields
description: Verify that the project creation fails with validation errors when mandatory fields are missing.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher
Navigate to the project creation form
Leave mandatory fields such as title or summary empty
Submit the project creation form
Verify that the API returns a 400 Bad Request response with validation error details

title: Update an existing project
description: Verify that authenticated users can update project details correctly with valid changes and receive confirmation.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher owning a project
Retrieve an existing project details
Modify project fields such as status, keywords, budget
Submit the update request via PUT to the project API
Verify a 200 OK response with updated project data
Confirm that changes persist and are reflected in the database and UI

title: Update non-existing project
description: Verify that attempting to update a project that does not exist returns the appropriate error.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher
Send a PUT request to update a non-existent project ID
Verify that a 404 Not Found error is returned

title: Create new product linked to existing project
description: Test creating a product linked to an existing project with valid data including product type and optional file attachments.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher
Select an existing project to associate the product with
Fill product details including title, summary, productTypeId, projectId
Submit the product creation request
Confirm the product creation with a 201 Created response and correct association to the project

title: Create product with invalid product type or project
description: Verify that product creation fails with errors if product type ID or project ID does not exist.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher
Attempt to create a product using invalid or non-existing productTypeId or projectId
Verify that the API returns 404 Not Found errors for missing project or product type

title: Update product details
description: Ensure that product details can be updated successfully and changes are persisted.

steps.description: Login as an authenticated researcher
Retrieve an existing product associated with the user's project
Modify product fields such as title, summary, productUrl, visibility
Submit the product update request via PUT
Confirm the API returns 200 OK with updated product details

title: Retrieve list of product types
description: Verify that the API returns a list of 20 product types with id, name, description, and category.

steps.description: Send a GET request to the product-types API endpoint
Verify the response is 200 OK with an array containing 20 product types with correct fields

title: Public project exploration with search and pagination
description: Test that unauthenticated users can query public projects using search terms with correct pagination controls.

steps.description: Send unauthenticated GET requests to the public projects API with various search keywords, limits, and offsets
Verify the response status is 200 OK and contains matching projects only marked as public
Confirm pagination metadata correctly reflects total, limit, offset, and hasMore flag

title: File upload for project entity with valid permissions
description: Verify that logged-in users can upload files securely to projects via Cloudinary integration and receive upload success response.

steps.description: Authenticate as a user with permission to modify a project
Upload a valid file with correct entityType 'project' and valid entityId
Verify response indicates success and returns attachment metadata including URL
Confirm the file is stored and accessible with correct permissions

title: File upload rejected for invalid file or missing required parameters
description: Ensure file upload endpoint rejects requests missing required fields or containing unsupported file formats.

steps.description: Authenticate as a valid user
Attempt to upload without file, missing entityType, or invalid entityId
Verify the API returns 400 Bad Request error

title: Delete uploaded file with proper permissions
description: Verify that users can delete uploaded files associated with projects or products if authorized.

steps.description: Authenticate as a user authorized to manage the file's entity
Send a DELETE request with a valid file ID to the upload API
Confirm response indicates successful file deletion
Verify the file is no longer accessible

title: Delete file fails without permission or invalid file ID
description: Ensure file deletion fails and returns errors if user lacks permission or file ID does not exist.

steps.description: Authenticate as a user without permission to delete the file
Attempt to delete file using invalid or unauthorized file ID
Verify receiving either 401 Unauthorized or 404 Not Found response

title: IA Evaluation engine provides scoring and recommendations
description: Verify that submitting a project proposal for AI evaluation returns accurate scoring, recommendations, and suggestions displayed correctly to the user.

steps.description: Login as a researcher
Submit a project proposal for evaluation via the IA evaluation engine
Verify the response contains a numeric score, qualitative recommendations, and actionable suggestions
Confirm UI displays evaluation results properly

title: Chatbot provides relevant responses on project formulation
description: Test that the conversational assistant/chatbot returns accurate, helpful, and relevant answers regarding formulation and categorization of CTeI projects.

steps.description: Login as a researcher
Ask the chatbot various questions about project formulation and product types
Verify the chatbot replies with relevant and comprehensible responses

title: Dashboard project listing with search and filtering
description: Verify that the dashboard shows a correct list of authenticated user's projects and supports search, filter by status, and multiple collaborator associations.

steps.description: Login as researcher with multiple projects and collaborators
Navigate to the dashboard
Perform searches using project titles and keywords
Filter projects by status (PROPOSED, IN_PROGRESS, etc.)
Confirm the displayed results match search and filter criteria
Verify projects correctly show associated collaborators

title: Public portal access without authentication
description: Ensure that unauthenticated users can access the public portal and explore public projects in read-only mode with functional filters and information.

steps.description: Access the public portal website without authentication
Use filters and search to navigate public projects
Verify the projects shown are only those with isPublic flag set
Confirm read-only access to project details and associated products

title: Responsive UI and accessibility compliance
description: Verify that all user interface pages comply with responsive design and WCAG accessibility standards across desktop and tablet devices.

steps.description: Open the main platform pages on desktop and tablet viewports
Test navigation and interaction elements for usability and keyboard accessibility
Confirm layout adjusts correctly and content is fully accessible according to WCAG
